description: This file defines the interface for a cache management module related to instance number lookup and synchronization, as part of a larger software system. It includes function declarations for initializing, destroying, monitoring, and updating a cache based on search expressions and node changes.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys the cache and releases resources.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_WatchUniqueKey
methods.description: Adds a watch for a unique key based on specified parameters to track instances.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_UnwatchUniqueKey
methods.description: Removes the watch for a previously monitored unique key selection.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_StartSEResolution
methods.description: Begins the process of solving or resolving instances in the cache.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_WatchAllUniqueKeysOnUspService
methods.description: Sets up watches for all unique keys on a specified USP service group.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_NotifyInstanceAdded
methods.description: Notifies the cache system that a new instance has been added at a specific path.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_NotifyInstanceDeleted
methods.description: Informs the cache system that an instance has been removed from a specific path.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_RefreshPermissions
methods.description: Updates permissions in the cache based on a specific node.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_HandleUspServiceDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection events for a USP service group.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_Dump
methods.description: Outputs the current cache state for debugging or inspection.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_IsWatchingSelector
methods.description: Checks if a selector is currently being watched.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_IsWatchingNode
methods.description: Checks if a node is currently being watched.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_IsSelectorInstanceStale
methods.description: Determines if a selector instance is stale relative to a node.
